autoDJ.uncheckedHint: Unchecked folders will be ignored in all DB queries (including Auto DJ)
autoDJ.heroDescription: Pick a corner of your library and let it run.
autoDJ.sourcesHint: Tracks come from the libraries you select. Click to toggle.
autoDJ.limitHint: How many songs Auto DJ queues each time it runs (1–{{max}}). Continuity filters judge the whole batch against the song playing when it was fetched.
autoDJ.similarHint: Bias picks toward artists Last.fm says are similar to the current song.
autoDJ.similarHintNoKey: No Last.fm API key configured on the server.
autoDJ.bpmContinuityHint: Prefer picks within a tempo window of the current song. Honours octave equivalence (half / double tempo).
autoDJ.harmonicMixingHint: Prefer picks in keys that mix well with the current song (Camelot wheel neighbours).
autoDJ.keywordFilterHint: Skip picks whose title, artist, album, or filepath contains any of these words.
autoDJ.keywordFilterPlaceholder: Add a word and press Enter…
autoDJ.genreFilterHint: Whitelist plays only matching tracks; blacklist skips them.
autoDJ.genreInputLabel: Add a genre to the filter
autoDJ.genreHintEmpty: No genre tags found in your library.
autoDJ.genreHintAuth: Please log in to see your genres.
autoDJ.genreHintError: Couldn't load genres. Reload the panel to retry.
autoDJ.genreNoMatches: No tracks match the current genre filter. Adjust the list, switch mode, or turn it off.
autoDJ.durationFilterHint: Only play tracks inside this length window. Leave a field empty for no limit on that side.
autoDJ.durationUnknownHint: Tracks the scanner couldn't read a length from are skipped by default.
autoDJ.durationNoMatch: No tracks match the current length window. Widen it or turn it off.
autoDJ.sonicHint: Only pick songs that sound like the session (uses the discovery scan).
autoDJ.sonicHintNoDiscovery: Requires the discovery feature, which is not enabled on this server.
autoDJ.sonicAnchorRollingHint: Each pick follows the session's recent sound — it can slowly evolve.
autoDJ.sonicAnchorLockedHint: Every pick stays close to the seed song for the whole session.
autoDJ.sonicSeedHint: Where the session starts. Optional while something is playing — required to start Auto DJ on an empty queue.
autoDJ.sonicSeedNone: No seed — the playing song anchors the session.
autoDJ.sonicSeedNeeded: Sonic similarity is on but nothing is playing. Pick a seed song in the Auto DJ panel.
autoDJ.sonicNoMatch: No songs are within the similarity range. Loosen the match slider or adjust your filters.
autoDJ.sonicSeedUnanalyzed: That song hasn't been analyzed yet. Pick another seed or wait for the discovery scan.
autoDJ.federatedHint: Also ask every federated server that shares this server's discovery model, and play whichever answers closest to the session's sound.
autoDJ.similarInfoBodyMore: Picked something close to {{source}}. Considered: {{candidates}} (+{{extra}} more).
autoDJ.statusOn: Auto DJ is on. The next song will be picked for you.

admin.dplugins.title: Discovery Plugins
admin.dplugins.lead: What people can do with a Discover recommendation — a song the discovery network or a paired server suggested that this library does not have. Each plug-in adds one row to the recommendation window. A plug-in that is off, or that cannot run, has no row: nothing is ever shown locked.
admin.dplugins.group.getItHint: runs as a job · gated by the Jobs tab
admin.dplugins.group.sendToHint: hands it to another service · runs as a job
admin.dplugins.ytdlpOld: about {{count}} months old. YouTube changes often, so update it if downloads start failing
admin.dplugins.status.hiddenFromUsers: Until that is fixed nobody sees a {{title}} row.
admin.dplugins.ytdlpConfigNote: Which yt-dlp runs is discoveryPlugins.youtube.binary in the config file — a command on the server’s PATH or a full path; a restart applies it.
admin.dplugins.jobs.applies: Applies to Get it and Send to. Changes apply immediately.
admin.dplugins.jobs.allHint: everyone signed in can download and copy.
admin.dplugins.jobs.allPublic: everyone who can reach this server can download and copy.
admin.dplugins.jobs.whitelistHint: only the accounts you tick below.
admin.dplugins.jobs.whitelistNoUsers: needs user accounts. Add users on the Users view first.
admin.dplugins.jobs.noUsers: This server has no user accounts, so anyone who can open it can start downloads. To limit that, add users, or switch the Get it plug-ins off on the Plug-ins tab.
admin.dplugins.jobs.uploadNote: A download and a copy from a paired server both put a file into a library, so both need the account’s upload right as well (Users view) and respect “File Uploading” on the Settings view.
admin.dplugins.jobs.noUploadNote: {{users}} may start jobs but cannot upload, so a download or a copy fails for them with that reason until the account may upload. Being an admin does not skip the list.
admin.dplugins.jobs.atOnceNote: Across every plug-in. Each plug-in also limits itself (one copy, one download at a time).
admin.dplugins.jobs.historyNote: Done, failed and cancelled rows older than this leave the Activity tab. Files are not touched.
admin.dplugins.jobs.sweeping: Looking for old job rows and leftover staging folders…
admin.dplugins.jobs.passNote: The pass prunes finished job rows past the clock above and removes staging folders a crash left behind. It runs by itself 90 seconds after a start and then every 6 hours.
admin.dplugins.jobs.sweepResult: Pruned {{jobs}} old job rows and removed {{staging}} leftover staging folders.
admin.dplugins.dl.songsSub: still in a library · every account
admin.dplugins.dl.onDiskSub: as recorded when each file landed
admin.dplugins.dl.note: A download or a copy lands in the user’s own collection folder like any upload, with a record of where it came from. Removing one here deletes the file, its library row and the record — the same as the user’s own Remove.
admin.dplugins.dl.empty: Nothing yet. When someone presses Download or “Add to your collection” in the recommendation window, the song shows up here.
admin.dplugins.dl.removeAskSub: The file is deleted from the library. The plug-in can fetch it again later.
admin.dplugins.dl.removeSettle: The file is already gone — this clears the entry.
admin.dplugins.dl.inUse: The file is in use — try again in a moment
admin.dplugins.dl.footer: A file removed by hand or lost by a scan shows as missing; its entry stays until someone removes it.
admin.dplugins.act.empty: No jobs yet. When someone presses Download or “Add to your collection” in the recommendation window, it shows up here.

admin.dplugins.act.footer.one: The last 100 jobs. Finished jobs leave this list after {{count}} day (Jobs tab).
admin.dplugins.act.footer.other: The last 100 jobs. Finished jobs leave this list after {{count}} days (Jobs tab).

admin.dplugins.act.hint.botCheck: This one is YouTube’s doing, not the server’s: it throttles addresses that download a lot. Updating yt-dlp often helps.
admin.dplugins.act.hint.ytdlpStale: This is usually an out-of-date yt-dlp: YouTube changes often and older versions get refused. Update yt-dlp on the server (its own warnings also ask for a JavaScript runtime such as Deno) and try the download again. The Plug-ins tab shows the version this server found.
admin.dplugins.act.hint.noMatch: The search found nothing close enough to this song, so nothing was downloaded rather than the wrong thing.
admin.dplugins.act.hint.peerLimit: The paired server’s daily limit for this server’s key was spent. It resets on their side.
admin.dplugins.act.hint.peerUnreachable: The paired server did not answer. It may be offline.
admin.dplugins.act.hint.uploadsOff: The account may not upload, and a download or a copy puts a file into a library (Users view).
admin.dplugins.act.hint.noLibrary: The account has no library it can write to.
admin.dplugins.toast.failed: That did not save — try again
admin.dplugins.toast.gateAll: Jobs are open to all users
admin.dplugins.toast.gateWhitelist: Jobs are limited to the whitelist
admin.dplugins.field.youtube.codecHelp: Converting is ffmpeg’s job; FLAC and WAV do not add quality to a lossy source.
admin.dplugins.field.youtube.maxFilesize: 1 – 4096. A bigger file is refused before it lands.
admin.dplugins.field.youtube.searchResul: 1 – 20. More results, slower search, better odds.
admin.dplugins.field.youtube.note: A download lands in the user’s collection folder like a copy from a peer, so the account needs the upload right. The Downloads tab lists what landed. Which yt-dlp runs is not set here: it is discoveryPlugins.youtube.binary in the config file, and the plug-in’s row shows the one in use.
admin.dplugins.field.itunes.countryHelp: A two-letter country code. Catalogues and store links differ per storefront; pick the one most of your users buy from.
admin.dplugins.num.maxConcurrent.title: Jobs at once
admin.dplugins.num.maxConcurrent.label: Jobs running at the same time
admin.dplugins.num.maxConcurrent.help: 1 – 16. Downloads and copies are disk and network work; a small number keeps playback smooth. Takes effect on the next job, no restart.
admin.dplugins.num.retentionDays.title: Finished jobs kept for
admin.dplugins.num.retentionDays.label: Days a finished job stays on the Activity tab
admin.dplugins.num.retentionDays.help: 1 – 3650. Only the rows go; files are not touched.
